title: FBI Photo B18
what_is_it: A monochrome still image (photo) captured by a U.S. military system showing two unidentified objects, submitted by the FBI to AARO.
interpretation_warnings: The PDF page contains only an image with no extractable text — all factual claims derive from the CSV metadata and narrative description provided by war.gov, not from text within the document itself.
The original image was redacted before submission to AARO, meaning potentially identifying sensor data, HUD overlays, or contextual information has been removed.
No mission report accompanied this image, so there is no operational context for the sighting.
The date shown in the image is confirmed unreliable due to the system clock not being set.
Single-source observation with no corroborating sensor data or witness accounts provided.
The narrative description explicitly states it should not be interpreted as reflecting any analytical judgment or factual determination about the event.
